The levelised cost of electricity for fixed-bottom projects fell to 61 EUR/MWh in the synthetic 2025
auction round, down from 74 EUR/MWh in 2023. Floating projects remain above 120 EUR/MWh.
FlCE attributes thedecline tolarger turbines(15 MWclass)andlower financing costs.

1. Summary
Installed offshore wind capacity in the fictional Tidewater region reached 4.2 GW at the end of
2025. FICE projects 9.8 GW by 2030 if the Marlow Bank auction clears on schedule. Grid
connection queues remain the main constraint; the average wait for a connection offer rose from 14
to 22 months.
